title: Sharing and taking turns
examples: Teacher, what does it mean to be fair?
When do I get a turn with the red crayon?
Is it okay if I take a toy without asking?

explain.say: Today we are learning about sharing things with friends.
Sharing means letting others use what you have too.
Fairness means everyone gets a turn or gets the same amount.
Waiting is important when you want to play with something.
Kindness means thinking about how others feel while you play.
When you are building a tower, you must wait for your friend to finish their part.

items: You wait for the next turn

faq.q: Why is it important to take turns?
faq.a: Taking turns makes sure everyone gets a chance to play and have fun. It shows you care about your friends.
asks: Why should I wait my turn?

faq.q: What does 'fair' mean when we play games?
faq.a: Fair means that everyone follows the same rules and gets a chance to do things. It means treating everyone equally.
asks: How do I know if something is fair?

faq.q: Can kindness help when I want a toy right now?
faq.a: Yes, being kind means you can ask nicely or wait patiently. It makes your friend feel good.
asks: How can I be kind when I want something?
Is waiting a kind thing to do?

faq.q: If I share my crayons, do I have to share them forever?
faq.a: No, sharing means letting others use them for a little while. You can use them again later too.
asks: Does sharing mean I lose them?
Can I use my things again?

faq.q: What if my friend doesn't want to share?
faq.a: You can use your kind words to talk to them and explain why sharing is fun. You can also ask a grown-up for help.
asks: Who do I tell if they won't share?

facts: Sharing toys makes playtime more fun for everyone.
Fairness means everyone gets a turn when playing games.
Waiting shows that you are patient and kind to your friends.
Kindness is using gentle words and actions with others.

quiz.say: You want to play with the red truck, but your friend is using it right now. What should you do?

options.show: Take the truck gently from their hands.
options.say: Take the truck gently from their hands.

options.show: Cry loudly until they give it to you.
options.say: Cry loudly until they give it to you.

options.show: Push them gently until they let go.
options.say: Push them gently until they let go.

options.show: Wait patiently until your friend is finished.
options.say: Wait patiently until your friend is finished.

quiz.why: Waiting shows you are patient and respects your friend's turn.

wrong.0: This is not fair because you took it without asking.
wrong.1: Crying does not teach fairness or kindness.
wrong.2: Pushing is not kind and can make friends feel scared.

quiz.say: Your friend has a big box of blocks. You want to build a tall tower. What is the fairest thing to do?

options.show: Take turns building the tower together.
options.say: Take turns building the tower together.

options.show: Only use the blue blocks for your tower.
options.say: Only use the blue blocks for your tower.

options.show: Ask your teacher to give you all the blocks.
options.say: Ask your teacher to give you all the blocks.

options.show: Wait until the friend gets bored of the blocks.
options.say: Wait until the friend gets bored of the blocks.

quiz.why: Taking turns means you both get a chance to use the blocks.

wrong.1: This is not fair because you are ignoring the other colors.
wrong.2: This is not sharing, and friends should help you.
wrong.3: Waiting for them to get bored is not being kind.

quiz.say: Your friend accidentally knocks over your drawing. What is the kindest thing to say?

options.show: Ignore them and just start drawing again.
options.say: Ignore them and just start drawing again.

options.show: Say, 'It is okay, but please be careful.'
options.say: Say, 'It is okay, but please be careful.'

options.show: Run away and not talk to them.
options.say: Run away and not talk to them.

quiz.why: This is kind because it tells them what happened but keeps the friendship safe.

wrong.0: Ignoring them does not help solve the problem of the drawing.
wrong.2: Yelling is not kind and makes the friend feel bad.
wrong.3: Running away is not solving the problem with kindness.
